meta.title: gui: Refactor useEffect to useMemo
meta.body_summary: Refactor multiple useEffect calls to useMemo to eliminate unnecessary re-renders, improving React rendering performance.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor refactored useEffect to useMemo across multiple components; merged after maintainer manually verified functionality and reviewer suggested more tests (non-blocking).

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 640 changed lines across 8 files, this is a small-to-medium refactor by absolute volume, concentrated in React component logic. It fits a typical small-step performance improvement PR that merged after a non-blocking review suggestion.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewer ejkorol commented that writing more tests would help ensure stability, but did not block the merge.
review_details.performance_claim: Eliminate unnecessary re-renders by converting useEffect+useState patterns to useMemo for derived state.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Cursor successfully refactored multiple components according to React best practices; merge gated only on human manual testing and a non-blocking suggestion for more tests.

detection_detail.code_reading: Author reviewed the refactoring by reading the code and applying React best practices; no profiling or automated perf measurement.
detection_detail.manual_inspection: Author manually tested the GUI to ensure functionality after the refactoring.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after performance data; manual functional verification only.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: The refactoring itself aimed to fix inefficiency; no regression was introduced. The PR was merged after manual verification.

core_change_summary.description: Multiple React components refactored to replace useEffect+useState with useMemo for derived state to eliminate redundant render cycles. An analysis markdown was added by Cursor and later deleted.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The analysis markdown (250 lines) was added by Cursor and later deleted; the snapshot file was updated due to the refactor.
